models_evaluated: DLA1 (commercial FDA-cleared, CE-marked prostate segmentation algorithm)
DLA2 (commercial FDA-cleared, CE-marked prostate segmentation algorithm)

links.outcome: Local validation of commercial prostate segmentation AI against expert radiologist reference on heterogeneous clinical MRI data
links.effect: DSC 0.90±0.05 for DLA1 and 0.89±0.04 for DLA2 versus expert reference; no significant difference between algorithms (p=0.8); 123 patients across 7 hospitals, 8 scanners.
links.quote: The DSC mean and standard deviation for DLA1 versus the radiologist reference standard (RSexp) was 0.90±0.05 and for DLA2 versus RSexp it was 0.89±0.04.

screen.reason: Retrospective external validation of two commercially available, regulatory-cleared AI tools across heterogeneous multicenter MRI scans, evaluating algorithmic segmentation accuracy compared to an expert radiologist.
